description: This file defines the class TestDataService within the OrangeHRM testing utilities. It provides methods for populating, truncating, and managing test fixture data in a database, particularly for unit testing or integration testing of the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with Doctrine ORM, manages fixture files in YAML format, and handles database transactions for test setup.

classes.name: TestDataService
classes.description: Utility class for managing test fixtures and database state during testing in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Loads fixture data from a file and populates the database, with optional cache reset.

methods.name: _populateUsingPdoTransaction
methods.description: Internal method that performs database population within a PDO transaction, managing constraints and cache.

methods.name: _generatePdoInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generates SQL insert queries for a given table and data.

methods.name: _generateMultipleInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Creates multiple insert queries for batch inserting fixture data into the database.

methods.name: _generateInsetQueryColumnString
methods.description: Constructs the column part of an SQL insert statement based on fixture data.

methods.name: _getTableName
methods.description: Retrieves the database table name for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _getClassMetadata
methods.description: Gets Doctrine ORM ClassMetadata for an entity alias.

methods.name: _setData
methods.description: Loads and processes fixture data from a file.

methods.name: _encryptFieldsInFixture
methods.description: Encrypts specified fields in fixture data if encryption is configured.

methods.name: getFQEntityName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name for an entity alias.

methods.name: _setTableNames
methods.description: Extracts table names from fixture data and stores them.

methods.name: _disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints in the database.

methods.name: _enableConstraints
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key constraints.

methods.name: _truncateTables
methods.description: Deletes all data from specified tables and resets their auto-increment counters.

methods.name: _getDbConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection from Doctrine's EntityManager.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Public method for truncating tables by alias list.

methods.name: truncateSpecificTables
methods.description: Truncates specific tables by alias list, clearing Doctrine's EntityManager.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecords
methods.description: Fetches the latest inserted records of a given entity, based on count.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecord
methods.description: Fetches the most recently inserted single record for an entity based on order.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entity object by primary key.

methods.name: parseFixtureFile
methods.description: Parses a fixture YAML file into an array, with caching.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for a specific key from a file.

methods.name: loadObjectList
methods.description: Loads a list of objects from fixture data, given a fixture file and key.

methods.name: loadObjectListFromArray
methods.description: Creates entity objects from an array of fixture data.

methods.name: getFieldForColumn
methods.description: Maps a database column to an entity field name.

methods.name: getTypeForField
methods.description: Gets the data type of a field in a Doctrine entity metadata.

methods.name: getAssociationMapping
methods.description: Retrieves association mapping info for a given field.
